svg.title: Latency distributions across three benchmark tasks

cc:Work.dc:title: Latency distributions across three benchmark tasks
cc:Work.dc:description: Empirical cumulative distribution of end-to-end non-streaming latency for each task, using 60 measured requests per model per panel. Each step represents observed calls, with common logarithmic time axes. Two warmup requests per model are excluded. Timing includes network, OpenRouter, and provider processing; it is not isolated model inference time. Solid navy denotes Jev and dashed orange denotes Luna.
